comments: Chosen assumptions: ego makes a scripted left lateral evasion after 2 s at 8-9 m/s; agent1 approaches in the target lane from 16-18 m behind at 11-12 m/s and brakes after detecting the incursion, with a 0.3-0.5 s reaction delay. Both are cars travelling in the same direction on one trafficway. Ego is the initiator and agent1 the responder. The perceived hazard motivating the evasion is not a third conflict partner. Seven-second horizon; conflict opportunity, no collision requirement.
